en: A multi‑view color postcard with an orange border showing several scenes from the city of Pécs. The main images include a panoramic view of the city with a TV tower on the nearby hill, the central square with the mosque‑church with a large green dome and surrounding historic buildings, a view of the ornate City Hall, a pedestrian street lined with old houses, and a church with a tower and a small square in front. In the center there is a city emblem with a stylized bastion, red star and other symbols. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines, stamp box, and Hungarian text indicating the publisher and photographer.
